adaptations: components/ui/button.tsx: shared-ui button's base and variant classes without cva, Radix Slot, or tailwind-merge; sizes carry their own text, gap, and icon size, plus a 28px xs size and bb's 28px header icon button.
components/ui/input.tsx: shared-ui input's classes with plugin-local default and sm sizes.

components/ui/menu.tsx: dropdown-menu's content and item look on plain elements (no Radix), rendered in place inside the plugin's styling scope, with arrow, Home, End, Esc, and outside-click handling.
components/ui/dialog.tsx: dialog's content look on plain elements (no Radix), covering the Space tab instead of the window, with Tab trapping, Esc, scrim click, and focus return.
components/status-glyph.tsx: plugins/thread-list/app/rows/ThreadStatusGlyph.tsx icons, tones, motion, and labels, drawn from experimental_Icon, plus the red glyph a read failure keeps.
components/model.ts: thread-list's RUNNING_RUNTIME_STATUSES and THREAD_LIST_INDICATOR_LABELS from plugins/thread-list/app/model/thread-activity.ts.
